import { Aside, Card, CardGrid, LinkCard } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';
import CatalogBrowser from '../../../../../components/CatalogBrowser.astro';

External skills are authored in `docs/src/authoring/skills/*.mdx` and emitted to `docs/public/generated-registries/skills-catalog-index.json`. With `--include-installed`, local harness inventory may add rows.

<Aside type="note" title="Trust and provenance">
Audit third-party skills before install. Use [review source](/skills/catalog/custom/review/) and the maintainer notes on each row. For harness install/sync policy, see [Harness Support](/harness-support/).
</Aside>

<div class="stats-bar">
  <span class="stat stat-skill">640 External Skills</span>
  <span class="stat stat-installed">233 Install now</span>
  <span class="stat stat-agent">176 Inspect</span>
</div>
